outcome: native T1 and T2 values on cardiac MRI
cohort: A 35-year-old woman diagnosed with peripartum mid-ventricular-type Takotsubo cardiomyopathy after caesarean delivery
finding: Serial cardiac MRI may be useful in differentiating Takotsubo cardiomyopathy from other cardiomyopathies during pregnancy and the postpartum period, as demonstrated in this case where a woman with peripartum Takotsubo cardiomyopathy showed recovery of left ventricular function and normalization of cardiac MRI findings within a week.
mod_finding: This case report describes a woman who developed Takotsubo cardiomyopathy after cesarean delivery.
